decision.reason: Operator-frozen hypothesis: retain the ETHUSDT 1m downside/volume trigger and use the volume-weighted close of the fifteen immediately preceding closed 1m bars as a causal VWMA proxy target. No parameter optimization or target stretching is permitted.
